bracu_official.title: BRAC University organizes yoga session to promote mental wellbeing
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University hosted a yoga session to encourage mental wellbeing among its students and staff. The event aimed to promote a healthy lifestyle on campus.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University VC calls for community learning and values-driven leadership
bracu_official.summary: The Vice Chancellor of BRAC University delivered a speech emphasizing the importance of community learning and leadership rooted in strong values. This highlights the university's commitment to holistic development.

bracu_official.title: Defense adviser gives lecture at BRAC University
bracu_official.summary: A defense adviser visited BRAC University to deliver a lecture. The session provided valuable insights into defense-related topics for the university community.
